rule.freeze: results/hybrid_short_T/routing/routing.json is written once from the benchmark summary, with the engine source hashes, BEFORE any production run; production refuses to start without it or if the engine sources changed
rule.rule: Per system and N, from the ABF benchmark only (median over the uncontended repeats of c_ss): P* = the fastest parallel thread count; any parallel config within 3 % of it counts as tied and the tie goes to fewer threads.  Route N to P* iff median c_ss(P*) <= median c_ss(S1) / 1.05 AND every repeat of P* is faster than every repeat of S1; otherwise route N to S1.  ABF and FR at that N both run on the routed backend (common-backend primary analysis).
rule.secondary: deployment-optimised: the same rule applied to each method's own benchmark; where it differs from the common route, the alternative wall time is a PROJECTION (measured W x c_ss(own route) / c_ss(common route)), labelled as such
